name: h01_enter
args: h00_exterior_s55.png

Slow smooth steady cinematic camera dolly straight forward toward the white double door in the centre, the doors swing open and the camera glides through the doorway into a bright pastel pink cafe interior with white marble tables and pink velvet chairs, one continuous forward move

name: h02_table
args: h01_enter.mp4

Smooth steady camera glides forward through the pastel pink cafe between white marble tables, slowly approaching a small round white marble table beside a tall arched window, on the table sits a single pink ceramic cup of latte with heart latte art on a saucer, camera ends close to the table with the cup in the centre of frame

name: h03_cup
args: h02_table.mp4

The camera slowly rises upward and tilts down until it looks straight down from directly above the pink latte cup, a perfect top-down overhead view of the heart latte art in the centre of frame on the white marble table, smooth crane move

args: h03_cup.mp4
